title: koernickea lanata
intro: Koernickea lanata, commonly known as the woolly koernickea, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to promote respiratory health and alleviate symptoms associated with bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Koernickea lanata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and ease coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as bronchodilation, mucolytic activity, and immunomodulation.
